card.name: Overdose and reaction management wording
card.fires_on: Words naming a treatment response in overdose or infusion-reaction sections, such as management, administer, treatment, and the ends of antidote names like atropine and naloxone.

modes.label: Treatment verbs and nouns
modes.description: Management, administer or treatment right after an instruction to stop or in overdose guidance.
